main_body: A dead/gothic weeping-willow style tree with a drooping dark brown canopy of hanging branches and a thick trunk with a hollow, standing on a dark base.
top_band: none - the canopy is an organic mass of dark brown strands with no distinct horizontal top band; the column scan shows only scattered outline-dark and mid-brown runs
evidence: The object is an organic tree. It has no rigid top/front structure, and the canopy reads as a volume of drooping branches in a roughly frontal view, with the trunk below. Organic kinds do not have a flat-top construction. The tree reads as a plausible organic silhouette with no isometric side faces and no flat elevation panel, so the 3/4 contract is not violated.

style.evidence: Measured facts: the candidate has 9 median colours per tile and only 12 distinct colours, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours for the references. 97% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is near-black rather than a tinted material tone. The brown ramp is only about 4 steps (near-black, dark brown, mid brown, light tan) with a few green and orange accent dots. It has no flat fills, but the strands are streaky and lack the clumped leaf shading and per-clump highlights of the references. It is much thinner and flatter than the references.
